regime.title: BS 10008 — evidential weight of electronic information

source.note: the standard is paywalled and was not read; no clause number is cited; topics follow docs/security/PROVENANCE_INTEROP.md §1.1; requirement text is our paraphrase of the topic

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: An information-management policy covers the electronic information whose evidential weight matters.
rows.mechanism: The operator pack lists what the policy names.
rows.operator_action: Write and adopt the information-management policy.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: Roles and a duty of care are assigned for that information.
rows.mechanism: The CPS and the operator pack name the roles.
rows.operator_action: Name the operator, trustees, reviewer and witness, with separation of duties.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.mechanism: The capture-provenance note says what the kernel records about the capture path.
rows.operator_action: Document each device, adapter and ruleset in the capture path.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: Stored information is protected from undetected change.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: Transfers of information keep their integrity, and the transfer is recorded.
rows.mechanism: Handoff sidecars and the court kit's manifest prove the copy by hash.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: Retention and disposal are planned and recorded.
rows.mechanism: Retention deletes event records up to a checkpoint; receipt ledgers are never pruned.
rows.operator_action: Set the retention period and record disposal.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: The people who act on the information are authenticated.
rows.mechanism: Trustee keys and the device seed authenticate custody acts.
rows.operator_action: Authenticate the people who hold seeds and trustee keys.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: An audit trail records what happened to the information.
rows.mechanism: Break-glass, export, policy-change and clock-provenance ledgers: append-only, hash-chained, device-signed.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.mechanism: Two TSAs and OpenTimestamps anchor the ledgers; the anchor policy is the operator's.
rows.operator_action: Configure the anchor policy and anchor on a cadence.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: Access to the information is controlled.
rows.mechanism: Host and database access are the deployment's; there is no role model in the software.
rows.operator_action: Restrict host accounts, physical access and the database key.

rows.clause: BS 10008 (topic; clause number not cited — standard not read)
rows.requirement: Outsourced services that handle the information are controlled.
rows.mechanism: The operator pack names what to record about a service provider.
rows.operator_action: Record each service provider that handles the information and the controls on it.
